_comment: InfluxDB schema contract for the soil-sensor project.
Every measurement/tag/field below is derived from the code that WRITES it
(see 'producer'). Grafana dashboards may only query what appears here — a
query that filters on a measurement or field that nothing writes renders as
Validated in CI by scripts/check-no-data-panels.py. When firmware or a Pi
collector starts writing a new field, add it here in the same commit.

sensor_reading.description: Soil moisture reading, posted every 5 minutes by each soil sensor.

climate_reading.description: Temperature/humidity reading from the DHT22 climate sensors.

sensor_heartbeat.description: Liveness beacon written by every sensor, independent of readings.

sensor_diagnostics.description: Discrete diagnostic events (crash, wifi reconnect, queue overflow, ...). The event kind is the 'event_type' TAG, not a field.

rpi_system_metrics.description: Raspberry Pi host metrics, collected on a systemd timer.
